newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE-Wash. Suburban Sanitation Dist, Md..

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
Washington Suburban Sanitary District, Maryland
$35,625,000 Water Supply Bonds of 1997
$35,625,000 Sewage Disposal Bonds of 1997
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Washington Suburban Sanitary Commission (the
Commission'') will rece
written sealed bids for the $35,625,000 Water Supply Bonds of 1997 and the $35,625,000 Sewage Disposal Bonds of 1997 (collectively, the
Bo
shington Suburban Sanitary District until 11:00 A.M. Eastern Daylight Time on

at 14501 Sweitzer Lane, Laurel, Maryland 20707. The Bonds will be dated June 1, 1997, and will mature on June 1 in the years and amounts as more fully described in the Notice of Sale. The Bonds are expected to be issued on June 26, 1997, through the facilities of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York.

No bids of less than 100% of par or more than 101% of par plus accrued interest, no oral bid and no bid for less than all of the Bonds will be considered. The Bonds will be awarded based on the lowest interest cost to the Commission, determined in accordance with the true interest cost (TIC) method. All bids must be accompanied by a good faith check or financial surety bond in the amount of $700,000, payable unconditionally to the order of the Washington Suburban Sanitary Commission.
The Bonds which mature on or after June 1, 2008 are subject to redemption prior to maturity, as provided in the Notice of Sale.
In order to assist the underwriters purchasing the Bonds in complying with Securities and Exchange Commission Rule 15c2-12(b)(5) (the Rule''), the Commission has by

resolution covenanted, for the benefit of the owners from time to time of the Bonds, to comply with the provisions of the Rule. The Preliminary Official Statement dated May 29, 1997 with respect to the Bonds included a description of the Commission's undertaking.
Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the Bonds may be obtained from the undersigned at Washington Suburban
Sanitary Commission, 14501 Sweitzer Lane, Laurel, Maryland 20707 (301-206-7108) or H.C. Wainwright &Co., Inc.,
Financial Advisor, 100 East Pratt Street, Baltimore,
Maryland 21202 (410-347-3900) or Pryor, McClendon, Counts & Co., Inc., 3 Penn Center, 1515 Market Street, Suite 819, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania 19102 (215-569-0274).
WASHINGTON SUBURBAN SANITARY COMMISSION
By: /s/ MARY J. KIRBY
Treasurer
(From The Bond Buyer)
